name: cozy-home-redhead-playful-selfie
image_purpose: Casual social-media portrait and home lifestyle post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical upper-body home selfie of an approved adult woman, preserving copper-red waves, freckles, gray fitted top, fingertip gesture, and visible lived-in background.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural copper-red softly wavy hair, light blue-gray eyes, very fair skin with sparse freckles, natural pores and blush, calm confident subtly playful expression, wearing a lightweight gray fitted cropped top with a moderate flattering neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Relaxed seated upper-body selfie with head, shoulders, and chest area visible; one fingertip rests near the lips and the other hand holds the camera slightly above eye level. Keep the entire head and hair in frame, background clearly visible and in focus with warm home details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm natural indoor light, flattering but realistic skin tones, deep focus without bokeh, cozy artistic home atmosphere and approachable everyday mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, vertical 9:16, slightly above eye-level perspective, deep focus, natural texture, realistic handheld framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 upper-body selfie of an approved adult woman with natural copper-red softly wavy hair, light blue-gray eyes, very fair skin with sparse freckles, natural pores and blush, calm confident subtly playful expression, wearing a lightweight gray fitted cropped top with a moderate flattering neckline. Seated comfortably with one fingertip near her lips and the other hand holding the camera slightly above eye level. Entire head and hair visible, warm cozy home background clearly in focus, soft natural indoor light, realistic skin tones, deep focus, casual elegant social-media mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, erotic framing, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body measurements, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurred background, bokeh, shallow depth of field, extra fingers, watermark

assets.name: cozy-home-redhead-playful-selfie.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's hair, freckles, face, gray top, fingertip gesture, camera angle, home background, and deep-focus lighting.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, hair, freckles, secure outfit, pose, framing, background, and lighting.
